title: 5c-1: module rename fca/ → conventions/ + convention_state migration
description:
## Parent

sutra/57 — 5c PRD: convention system design

## What to build

Rename `src/fca/` to `src/conventions/` and rename the `convention_overrides` table to `convention_state`. All existing functionality must work unchanged after the rename. This is a mechanical change — no logic modifications.

- Move `src/fca/*.rs` → `src/conventions/*.rs`
- Update `mod.rs` and all import paths across the codebase
- Add a migration renaming `convention_overrides` → `convention_state`
- Update all DB methods and types referencing the old table/type names (`ConventionOverrideRow` → `ConventionStateRow`, etc.)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `src/fca/` no longer exists; all FCA code lives under `src/conventions/`
- [ ] `convention_overrides` table renamed to `convention_state` via migration
- [ ] All Rust types/methods referencing the old names updated
- [ ] All existing tests pass
- [ ] `cargo check` and `cargo clippy` clean

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately

messages.author: opus-review
messages.text: Code review: APPROVE. Rename is complete and clean — src/fca/ removed, all types/methods updated, migration 0014 added, no stale references outside historical migration 0007. All tests pass, clippy clean (pre-existing warnings only).
